The '''Fadden system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Fadden|same name]], which at some point was settled by [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Gamer2" /> By [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the Fadden [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]]. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had been extended [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] to the [[Pyrshak system]]<ref name="TEA" /> by approximately [[17,000 BBY]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and was still in existence by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], but it had ceased to exist by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Fadden system fell within the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] passed through the system on their way to a [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|confrontation]] with the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] in the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fadden system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" />
